method: captured live through the rendering browser; trimmed only of icon tags — every attribute the extractor reads is verbatim

ground_truth.note: search «ноутбуки» at capture time: «Ноутбук Acer Gadget ERBook Air …» 59 990 ₽ was 66 990; «Ноутбук iRU Strato 16ALMR …» 55 170 ₽ with no strikethrough. The capture pins the three traps the extractor was fixed for: the first product anchor is an empty overlay link, the ₽ glyph renders in a sibling element to the digits, and the strikethrough price precedes the current price in DOM order next to a '-10%' badge and a 'в 1356 пунктов' delivery count.
